question.text: A close-ended Category III AIF's tenure can be extended by a maximum of how many years, and what is the required investor approval?

answer.text: Up to 3 years with 51% approval by value
Up to 2 years (with two 1-year extensions) requiring two-thirds approval by value
Up to 5 years with unanimous consent

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 114-115 of the workbook, a close-ended Cat III AIF's tenure may be extended by up to two additional years through two separate one-year extensions, each requiring approval of two-thirds of investors by value of their investment. The Trap: Simple majority (51%) and unanimity are not the prescribed thresholds; 5-year extensions apply to Large Value Funds, and indefinite extensions are not permitted. Note: The extension must be obtained from investors in the prescribed manner before the original tenure expires.
